pages.text: The $(l)Bounty Table$() offers three $(l)bounty scrolls$(). Each one is a job from the guild: clear vaults, hunt mobs, find loot or deliver items.$(br2)Pick a scroll to read it, $(l)take$() it, get it done and come back to the table to $(l)claim$() its reward.

Ordinary bounties pay $(l)Renown$() and one reward, from Common to Omega. Greed Bounties pay $(l)Greed Reputation$().$(br2)You can see the payout on the scroll before you take it. A finished bounty makes room for a new scroll right away.

pages.title: Bounty Hunter Rank
pages.text: Renown fills your $(l)Bounty Hunter Rank$(). Each of the first ten ranks has a reward you claim at the table, the first one being an $(l)Elytra$(). After that every rank pays a $(l)Bounty Crate$().$(br2)Higher ranks also make rarer bounty rewards more likely, a little less with every rank past ten.

pages.title: Refreshing the Board
pages.text: Don't like the scrolls on offer? $(l)Refresh$() the board for a little $(l)Vault Gold$(). Each refresh makes the next one a little pricier, each finished bounty brings the price back down.$(br2)Abandoning a bounty puts it back on the board and raises the price too.

pages.title: Deliveries
pages.text: Delivery bounties are handed in at the table with the $(l)Deliver$() button. It takes the items from your inventory, your backpacks and your shulker boxes.$(br2)Bounties written for a harder difficulty only make progress while you play on that difficulty or harder.
